messages:
Sophie (CS Ops): quick flag — OrchidBank's token usage dropped ~62% WoW after their product lead left last week. Procurement pinged us asking about pricing and alternatives. they mentioned a pilot with CompetitorX. https://app.metrics/OrchidBank/dashboard :eyes:
Ajay (CSM): ouch. timeline on the pilot?
Sophie (CS Ops): procurement said pilot kicks off in 2 weeks; renewal in 38 days.
Maria (CS Lead): set risk = amber for now. we should get a procurement + product sync. can we pull a short usage trend and top flows? @Eng Analytics Bot can you post the last 30d token/time series and top 5 routes by count?
Eng Analytics Bot: posting query + results snippet:
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE account_id = 'orchid_123' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
```
Results: tokens down 62% from previous 30d window. top routes: /generate/chat, /embed, /rerank, /summarize, /qa (descending). exported chart: https://dashboards.internal/plots/ob-usage-2141592653.png
Kyle (AE): I can join procurement call. will ask for pilot success criteria and timeline. pinging their buyer (cc @maria)
Ajay (CSM): recommend immediate: 1) schedule procurement call (owner: Kyle) 2) schedule product-requirements sync (owner: Ajay) 3) 2-week health check + enablement kit (owner: Sophie) 4) offer a short-term pilot credit / playbook (owner: Maria)
Maria (CS Lead): agree. propose we offer a demo session with success metrics mapped to latency/cost improvements — procurement cares about TCO. can we prepare a one-pager comparing our SLA/latency to CompetitorX?
Sophie (CS Ops): I'll assemble enablement kit and extract prompts + default configs they used. also will prepare playbook for retention discount options and escalation path.
Eng Analytics Bot: exported usage snapshot + anonymized request examples: https://s3.internal/ob/usage-snapshot-2141592653.json
Kyle (AE): I'll book procurement call for Tue 10am PT and invite product + CSM. sending calendar now. :calendar:
OpsBot: Reminder: renewal window for OrchidBank opens in 38 days (renewal_date=2141621453). SLA: standard 30d notice.
Ajay (CSM): for the procurement call agenda — 1) pilot objectives & eval criteria 2) performance & cost comparison 3) support & onboarding timeline 4) PO/contract questions. I'll draft and post a short agenda before EOD.
Maria (CS Lead): also loop in Solutions Eng for a quick tech dive — buyer asked about latency at 95p for 6k tokens. @Sophie please flag if we should run a sample trace.
Sophie (CS Ops): noted. I'll request traces from runtime team and get a pre-call perf snapshot.
Ajay (CSM): one more ask — capture the stakeholder map. who replaced the product lead? procurement contact is Claire H. new product lead is Rahul P (contractor). Sales team: any prior relationship?
Kyle (AE): Claire is new to this account; Rahul was introduced 11 days ago via their CTO. I'll share intros and past notes in the CRM.
Maria (CS Lead): ok. owners recap: Kyle=procurement call, Ajay=product sync & agenda, Sophie=enablement kit + perf traces, Maria=playbook + competitor one-pager. Let's reconvene after the procurement call to decide next steps (discount vs case study vs pilot credits). :thumbsup:
Sophie (CS Ops): logged as "account-risk:amber" in tracker and created follow-up task: https://tasks.internal/CS/2141592653
Kyle (AE): calendar invite sent.
Ajay (CSM): thanks team — will post post-call notes and next actions.
Maria (CS Lead): thanks — keep pressure on procurement convo. we should turn this into an expansion opportunity if we can solve their cost concerns.
OpsBot: channel alert closed (thread archived).
